question: What is Braniva and how do you help e-commerce & D2C brands?
answer: Braniva is an all-in-one e-commerce enablement agency. We manage marketplace onboarding (Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Myntra), performance marketing, custom D2C website development, A+ rich media creation, and 3PL logistics optimization so brands can launch and scale effortlessly.

question: How do we get started with Braniva for our brand launch?
answer: Getting started is simple! Book a free 30-minute consultation call at braniva.in/schedule or contact us at hello@braniva.in (+91 73038 72329). We review your product catalog, target channels, and paperwork to build a tailored onboarding roadmap.

question: What is your pricing model for marketplace onboarding & growth?
answer: We offer flexible engagement models tailored to your brand stage — including fixed monthly retainers, growth-based revenue-share arrangements, and hybrid structures combining base retainers with performance incentives.

question: Which marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms do you support?
answer: We manage end-to-end account setup, category approvals, and listing optimization across Amazon India, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, Meesho, Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart.

question: How long does it take to go from account setup to first live listing?
answer: On average, a structured onboarding engagement takes 14 to 30 business days from kickoff to your first live listing, depending on GST/trademark paperwork and category license reviews.

question: What documents and licenses are required to start selling on Indian marketplaces?
answer: Minimum requirements include GST Certificate & PAN, active bank account details, Trademark Certificate or Brand Authorization Letter, and category licenses (FSSAI, Cosmetic, BIS).

question: Do you manage advertising spend and ROAS optimization across platforms?
answer: Yes. We manage both on-platform ads (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, Quick Commerce placements) and off-platform campaigns (Meta & Google Ads) with continuous bidding and negative-keyword optimization.

question: What steps do you take to reduce Return-to-Origin (RTO) rates?
answer: We implement automated WhatsApp/IVR order confirmation flows, NDR buyer verification, COD-to-prepaid conversion incentives, and pincode risk scoring to minimize RTO losses.

question: Can you build or redesign a custom D2C storefront?
answer: Yes. We design and develop high-performance D2C storefronts on Next.js and Shopify with mobile-first UI/UX, custom analytics tracking, and streamlined high-conversion checkout engines.
